initialization: Every method uses the same frozen conditional parent for its task. Interval branches are initialized neutral; no scratch-trained main arm.

training.schedule: warmup plus cosine, same as existing examples
training.conditional_support: Entire batch has one target ray or one continuous wall scene; route labels never enter model
training.final_weight_selection: final EMA only; no best-checkpoint selection on validation or final

ot_cfm.coupling: Exact scipy Hungarian assignment, squared Euclidean full state, only within one condition; raw noise sample unchanged, permutation intentional

progressive.handoff: Every stage reinitializes live student+EMA from previous frozen stage EMA, fresh AdamW and stage-local cosine; two teacher steps per student step
progressive.evaluation: Use matching stage4/2/1 final EMA; cumulative trained updates1200/1600/2000; full cohort completes2000 before final bank

reflow.bank: Same fixed Gaussian→parent32endpoint pairs as endpoint method
reflow.path: linear interpolation between paired noise and parent endpoint

consistency.sampler: Denoise then re-noise in linear CFM convention; call times1,1-1/K,...,1/K; Gaussian re-noising extra draws separately registered and shared across conditions
consistency.history: actual model inputs and post-call endpoint predictions, explicit nonmonotone sampling events; no invented intermediate states

shortcut.target: Mean of two EMA half-shortcut velocities at actual first-step endpoint; at smallest half width query duration0

meanflow.time_sampling: sort two independent sigmoid(N(-0.4,1)) draws; t>=r
meanflow.target: stopgrad(v-d*JVP[u;(v,1,1)]) with native coordinates(x,t,d), holding r fixed
meanflow.metric: adaptive L2, p=1, c=0.001, weights detached; no higher-order optimization through JVP target

teacher_pairbank.reuse: Single train-only cache per task reused by all training seeds/methods; no endpoint quality filtering
teacher_pairbank.save_full_histories: private ignored cache only, selected small examples/public hashes

wall.conditions: continuous8; endpoints reconstructed, route ID evaluation-only

final.gate: ALL48 new full-budget runs and all stage4/2/1 exports fixed/hashed, validation selection record/source freeze verified before any new final data/noise generation; final bank cannot tune recipes

comparison.rays: Conditional rawXY SWD with requested-ray routing+outer correct fraction/coverage/radial+phase; no winner based only on global SWD
comparison.wall: Exact segment success primary, both modes over all requested scenes, mode balance, conditional raw60D SWD and lengths of valid paths
comparison.ranking: Per task and actual NFE; raw metrics+Pareto tiers, no arbitrary universal weighted score
comparison.uncertainty: Paired t95 intervals over three training seeds, conditional on one common parent and shared final bank; generated paths do not count as independent training repeats
comparison.cost: Common parent20000 cost plus offline teacher queries and per-method training cost disclosed; update counts are not equal wall-clock; extra interval parameters disclosed

historical_references.rule: Separate unequal-budget historical league; never paired seed CI against new training seeds
